title: Runway: a roadmap item (an item of runway.maps/<id> v1 with kind item)
description: start and end are inclusive dates. An item with no start may have a size instead; it then starts after its dependsOn items end (or at the roadmap's first period). Neither means unscheduled.

lane.description: A lane id, or null for no lane.

order.description: Position in its lane, for the outline.

parent.description: The item it sits under (same lane), or null. Optional; missing means null. Depth gives its level: 0 epic, 1 feature, 2 story, 3 task.

milestone.description: One date: start and end are the same.

notes.description: The description: what the item delivers. Shown under the timeline and in exports.

afterMissing.description: Names in the outline's after: that match no item, kept so the text round trips.

who.description: Owners: people (p_) and group (g_) ids from Workshop's people directory (workshop docs/people.md). Optional; missing means none.

ado.description: The linked Azure DevOps work item (optional).

assignee.description: ADO's Assigned To. Owners (`who`) come from it when People has someone with that ADO identity.

iteration.description: ADO's Iteration Path (its sprint). Publish can move the item to another sprint.

project.description: ADO's project, for the sprint list.

ownDates.description: ADO has its own start or target date, so its dates do not come from the sprint.

startDate.description: ADO's own Start Date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

targetDate.description: ADO's own Target Date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

titlePrefix.description: What Runway puts before a User Story's ADO title (its Feature and ' > '); empty for others.

remote.description: ADO's values when they differ from yours.

missing.description: The last refresh did not find the work item.

who.description: Owners from Assigned To. Missing in values saved before owners came from ADO.
